sample.verdict_evidence: Refuted as a comparative ranking, on this repository's own artifacts. aso-offtarget-duplex-energy.json: 175 of 190 designs carry a gap-paired NON-parent near-match; 45 carry one within 2 kcal/mol of their intended duplex; 8 carry a fully paired 16/16 off-target duplex at ddG 0.000, and 6 of those 8 are CURATED RefSeq records — LYPD6B NM_001317003 and ZNF215 NM_001354853 — not predicted models, so the manuscript's own 'mostly predicted transcript models' caveat does not dispose of them. The parent screen never produces a run longer than 13 bp anywhere in the panel. On count, on run length and on stability the strongest predicted wild-type liability is a non-parent transcript. ⚠ HONEST BOUND: the alignment screen excludes parent records by name and accession, so the energy artifact contains no parent record at all and the two arms are not on a common scale — which the manuscript's own next sentence concedes ('not on comparable terms'). This refutes the comparative as written, not the a-priori argument, for which no committed evidence exists either way.
